manifest.filterMethod: source_rule_id joins a deep-extraction business rule related to ENT-SEG-103 or one of its direct field entities

requirements.statement: Adjusted Product Code Data Segment (No. 157) added; data elements 76, 77, 81, 84, 85, 87, 106, and 107 updated with references to data segment 157.
requirements.constraint_text: These elements now reference Adjusted Product Code Data Segment (157)

requirements.statement: The device does not perform expiration date validation in an EBT card transaction.
All EBT transactions require PIN entry except Food Stamp Electronic Voucher, Food Stamp Reversal (Void), and Cash Benefit Reversal (Void) transactions.

There is no stand-in mode for EBT transactions; USDA guidelines do not allow off-line processing, and no defined SAF EBT transaction format exists. If the retailer supports SAF EBT, retailer assumes all risk.
requirements.constraint_text: No stand-in/SAF mode supported by spec; retailer risk if implemented

requirements.statement: The balance field must not print on the receipt (do not print zeros).
requirements.constraint_text: Balance field must not be printed (no zeros)

requirements.statement: EBT processing supports Food stamps and Cash benefits tender types.
requirements.constraint_text: Tender type must be Food stamps or Cash benefits

requirements.statement: Electronic vouchers must prompt for Account Number, Approval Number, and Voucher Number.
requirements.constraint_text: Device must prompt for Account Number, Approval Number, and Voucher Number

requirements.statement: The device must allow for entry of the Voucher Number from the manual voucher ticket.
requirements.constraint_text: Device must allow entry of Voucher Number

requirements.statement: Supported EBT transaction types: Food Stamp Purchase, Food Stamp Reversal (Void), Food Stamp Return, Cash Benefit Purchase, Cash Benefit Reversal (Void), Food Stamp Balance Inquiry, Food Stamp Electronic Voucher, Cash Benefit Purchase with Cash Back, Cash Benefit Balance Inquiry, Time-out Reversal, Food Stamp Void of a Merchandise Return.
requirements.constraint_text: Only listed transaction types are supported

requirements.statement: The food stamp dollar amount must be printed on a Food Stamp transaction receipt.
requirements.constraint_text: printed on a Food Stamp transaction receipt

requirements.statement: EBT card receipts must include Tender Type and Transaction Type, Clerk ID, Voucher Number, Transaction amounts, Balances, Approved messages, Declined messages, and Approved HIP transaction data.
Clerk ID is an optional EBT receipt requirement; may be retrieved via prompting or log on/log off and printed on receipt.
For Food Stamp Electronic Voucher transactions only, the manually entered Voucher Number must appear on the receipt.
requirements.constraint_text: Manually entered Voucher Number must be printed on receipt

requirements.statement: eWIC card receipts must include Payment Tender Type, Transaction Type, Clerk ID, Voucher ID, Transaction amounts, Balances, Approved messages, Declined messages, and Benefit expiration date (Earliest WIC Benefit Expiration Date subelement of Element 154 WIC Product Data).
Additional balances are returned providing the incentive earned for the transaction and month-to-date incentive earned; balances are reset at the beginning of the fiscal month.
requirements.constraint_text: Return transaction incentive and MTD incentive balances; reset at start of fiscal month

requirements.statement: Data element No. 164 (EBT Program Data) is used in the EBT Data Segment (Segment No. 103) to support the HIP feature.
requirements.constraint_text: EBT Program Data element must be present in EBT Data Segment

requirements.statement: Data Section No. 3 of a Financial Transaction Request contains none, one, or more of the following data segments: Fleet (101), Product Code (102), EBT (103), Purchase Card (104), Variable Information (111), per the Data Section No. 3 table.
requirements.constraint_text: Data Section No. 3 may include segments 101, 102, 103, 104, and/or 111 as applicable

requirements.statement: EBT Data Segment (103) is sent only on transactions requiring EBT data.
Segments 101â€“145 in Financial Transaction Request occupy Field Nos. 4â€“9 with specified maximum lengths (101:308, 102:381, 103:3334, 104:86, 111:999, 123:186, 135:110, 143:399, 145:999).
requirements.constraint_text: Adhere to stated max lengths in fields 4â€“9

requirements.statement: Segment 103 (EBT Data Segment) is sent only on transactions requiring EBT data.
Segment Type field 3 of Data Segment 132 has fixed value 132.
Field 1 Segment Type in Segment 100 has fixed value 100.
Segment Length includes the Segment Type's length and Field Separators.
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length value must include Segment Type length and Field Separators

requirements.statement: Segment Type field in the Fleet Data Segment has fixed value 101.
Segment Length field identifies the data segment's length, including the Segment Type field's length and Field Separators.
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length value must include Segment Type length and Field Separators

requirements.statement: A Field Separator always follows Segment Type and Segment Length. A Field Separator follows Product Amount when Product Amount is the very last element in the segment. When a field is not populated, still send the Field Separator.
requirements.constraint_text: Field Separator delimiter rules as stated

requirements.statement: When a Financial Transaction request includes the EBT Data Segment, all fields are separated by Field Separators; when a field is not populated, still send the Field Separator.
requirements.constraint_text: All fields separated by Field Separators, including empty fields

requirements.statement: When a Financial Transaction response includes the EBT Data Segment, there is no Field Separator between fields in this message.
Segment Length should be '4' for EBT with eWIC data transactions.
EBT Data Segment has a maximum length of 3,334 alphanumeric characters (01â€“3,334/aâ€“z/Aâ€“Z).
EBT Data Segment originates at the device and can appear in any of the fields in Data Section No. 3.
requirements.constraint_text: Origin: device; placement: Data Section No. 3

requirements.statement: Segment Type is a fixed value of 103 for the EBT Data Segment.
Segment Type field is fixed value 104 for the Purchase Card Data Segment.
For Totals Data Segment, Segment Type (Field 1) has fixed value 105.
Segment Type in Loyalty Card Data Segment is fixed value 108.
Segment Type (field 1) has fixed value 109 for the Electronic Mail Data Segment.
Segment Type for Data Segment No. 111 has fixed value 111.
Segment Type in segment 112 must be the fixed value 112.
Segment Type (field 1) is fixed value 113 for the ECA/TeleCheck Data Segment.
Segment Type field is a fixed value of 115 for the Print Data Segment.
Segment Type field for Proprietary Data Load Segment has a fixed value of 118.
When Prompt Code = 902 (Dynamic Card Table Data), Field 14 contains Card Table Data (max 3,600 bytes, Required); its length is determined by the segment length in field 2.
requirements.constraint_text: Field 14 = Card Table Data, Required, max length 3,600, length determined by segment length in Field 2

requirements.statement: In segment 119, Segment Type has fixed value 119.
Segment Type field contains fixed value '120' for the Print Data 2 Segment.
Segment Type (Field 1) must be the fixed value 123.
Segment Type field for CA Public Key File Data Segment has fixed value 132.
Field Nos 1 and 2, and 2 and 3, are separated by Field Separators. The segment should end with a field separator. Data fields contained within field 3 are not separated by Field Separators.
requirements.constraint_text: Fields 1/2 and 2/3 separated by Field Separators; segment ends with a field separator; internal fields inside field 3 (Moneris Data) are not separated

requirements.statement: Segment Type for Data Segment 135 has a fixed value of 135.
Segment Type for Moneris Data (Response) Segment must have the fixed value 136.
Segment Type must be the fixed value 139 for the Moneris Day End Batch Balance Request Segment.
Segment Length includes Segment Type's length and Field Separators.
Segment Type field 1 has fixed value 141.
Segment Type field in Segment 142 has a fixed value of 142.
Segment Type field of Data Segment 146 must be fixed value '146'.
Within Segment 148, Segment Type (field 1) has fixed value 148.
Segment Type field must be fixed value 151 for the Request InComm OTC Market Basket Data Segment.
Segment Type for Data Segment 152 has a fixed value of 152.
Segment Type for Network Token Data Request Segment is fixed at value 153.
Segment Type in segment 155 is a fixed value of 155, length 3, required.

In Segment 157, a Field Separator always follows Segment Type and Segment Length; a Field Separator follows Adjusted Product Amount only when it is the very last element; when a field is not populated, still send the Field Separator.
Segment Type for the Adjusted Product Code Data Segment has fixed value 157.
Segment Length Indicator indicates the data segment's length exclusive of the Data Type Indicator.
requirements.constraint_text: Length value excludes the Data Type Indicator byte

requirements.statement: When identifying a Clerk ID for ECA/TeleCheck processing, refer to Data Element No. 131, ECA/TeleCheck Clerk ID, instead of Data Element 18.
Clerk ID is variable length up to 10 digits; valid values 1â€“9999999999.
For Financial Transaction Requests, zero, one, or more of Data Segments 101 (Fleet), 102 (Product Code), 103 (EBT), 104 (Purchase Card), and 111 (Variable Information) may also follow.
requirements.constraint_text: Segments 101, 102, 103, 104, 111 are optional (none, one, or more)

requirements.statement: Segment Length has a length of four digits only when transmitting EBT Data Segment (103), SKU Data Segment (114), Print Data Segment (115), Proprietary Data Load Segment (118), Print Data 2 Segment (120), EMV Request Data Segment (130), or EMV Response Data Segment (131). It cannot be 4 digits for any other segment.
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length field is 4 digits; otherwise 3 digits

requirements.statement: Segment Length is calculated using the lengths of all data elements in the segment plus all Field Separators/Product Data Field Delimiters related to those elements.
requirements.constraint_text: Sum of element lengths plus separators/delimiters

requirements.statement: Standard Message Data Segment (No. 100) Segment Length valid values are 001â€“218.
Fleet Data Segment (No. 101) Segment Length valid values are 001â€“61.
Product Code Data Segment (No. 102) Segment Length valid values are 001â€“381.
EBT Data Segment (No. 103) Segment Length valid values are 001â€“3334.
Purchase Card Data Segment (No. 104) Segment Length valid values are 001â€“86.
Totals Data Segment (No. 105) Segment Length valid values are 001â€“409.
Loyalty Card Data Segment (No. 108) Segment Length valid values are 001â€“142.
Electronic Mail Data Segment (No. 109) Segment Length valid values are 001â€“232.
Check Data Segment (No. 110) Segment Length valid values are 001â€“168.
Variable Information Data Segment (No. 111) Segment Length valid values are 001â€“999.
Additional Information Data Segment (No. 112) Segment Length valid values are 001â€“999.
ECA/TeleCheck Data Segment (No. 113) Segment Length valid values are 001â€“156.
SKU Data Segment (No. 114) Segment Length valid values are 0001â€“1010.
Print Data Segment (No. 115) Segment Length valid values are 001-1009.
TransArmor Load Data Segment (No. 116) Segment Length valid values are 01â€“50.
Proprietary Data Load Segment (No. 118) Segment Length valid values are 0001-3800.
Totals with Proprietary Data Load Data Segment (No. 119) Segment Length valid values are 001-493.
Print Data 2 Segment (No. 120) Segment Length valid values are 001-1009.
NFC Payment Tokenization Data Segment (No. 123) Segment Length valid values are 001-186.
EMV Request Data Segment (No.130) Segment Length valid values are 001-3043.
EMV Response Data Segment (No. 131) Segment Length valid values are 001-3834.
CA Public Key File Data Segment (No. 132) Segment Length valid values are 01-77.
Transaction Attributes Data Segment (No. 134) Segment Length valid values are 01-19.
Adjusted Product Code Data Segment (No. 157) Segment Length valid values are 001â€“381.
Segment Type is required for the TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization Load Request.
Segment Type is a fixed length of three digits (N, max 3 bytes).
Voucher ID is required by some states when an EBT transaction is approved locally.
WIC Discount Amount appears in the EBT Data Segment (Segment No. 103).

WIC Discount Amount subfield structure: positions 1-2 Account Type (value 97), 3-4 Amount Type (value 52), 5-7 Currency Code (per Appendix L), 8-20 Amount formatted as x+n12 where x=0 or C (credit amount) or D (debit amount).
requirements.constraint_text: Account Type must be 97; Amount Type must be 52; Currency Code per Appendix L; Amount sign indicator must be 0, C, or D

requirements.statement: WIC Product Data is composed of a Total Length subelement plus one or more of: Earliest WIC Benefit Expiration Date, WIC Prescription Balance Information, WIC UPC Exception/Denial Information, WIC UPC Purchase Information.
requirements.constraint_text: Must contain Total Length and at least one listed subelement

requirements.statement: Earliest WIC Benefit Expiration Date is included in the eWIC Balance Inquiry Response, eWIC Authorization Response, and eWIC Purchase Completion Response.
requirements.constraint_text: Earliest WIC Benefit Expiration Date subelement present

requirements.statement: WIC Prescription Balance is included in the eWIC Balance Inquiry Response, eWIC Authorization Response, and eWIC Purchase Completion Response.
requirements.constraint_text: WIC Prescription Balance Information subelement present

requirements.statement: WIC UPC Exception/Denial Information is included in the eWIC Purchase Completion Response and eWIC Voucher Clear Response.
requirements.constraint_text: WIC UPC Exception/Denial Information subelement present

requirements.statement: For WIC purchases involving fruits and vegetables via the Cash Value Benefit (CVB), set the Quantity equal to the price in the WIC Purchase Information.
requirements.constraint_text: Quantity = price in WIC Purchase Information

requirements.statement: When WIC Purchase price exceeds the state-defined APL value, an exception record is returned in WIC Product Data reflecting both approved and original prices; the Settlement Amount is adjusted and returned in the Approved Amount field.
requirements.constraint_text: Exception record returned in WIC Product Data; adjusted total returned in Approved Amount

requirements.statement: Earliest WIC Benefit Expiration Date must be formatted as CCYYMMDD (8 numeric bytes) and identified with Data Set Identifier 'EF'.
requirements.constraint_text: Format CCYYMMDD; Data Set Identifier = EF

requirements.statement: If Item Action Code (Bit No. 8) is '00', the product was approved but the maximum price was exceeded; the Item price field (Bit No. 6) contains the price.
requirements.constraint_text: Item price (Bit No. 6) contains the approved price even though max price was exceeded

requirements.statement: The exact length of the UPC/PLU data (Bit No. 2), measured from the right-most digit, is specified in the UPC/PLU data length field (Bit No. 11).
requirements.constraint_text: UPC/PLU data length is defined by Bit No. 11

requirements.statement: The first position of the UPC/PLU data (Bit No. 2) indicates data type: 0 = UPC, 1 = PLU.
requirements.constraint_text: First digit of Bit No. 2 must be 0 (UPC) or 1 (PLU)

requirements.statement: EBT Program Data element has a variable maximum length of up to 267 alphanumeric bytes composed of Total Length (fixed 3 digits, appears once) and Program Data (max 264 alphanumeric bytes, 1-6 subelements each max 44 bytes).
requirements.constraint_text: Total Length = 3 digits fixed; Program Data â‰¤ 264 bytes with 1â€“6 subelements each â‰¤ 44 bytes

requirements.statement: EBT Program Data element is transmitted in Data Segment No. 103 (EBT Data Segment).
The total length of the EBT Program Data element is based on the number of Program Data subelements sent/received.
requirements.constraint_text: Total length varies with subelement count (1â€“6)

requirements.statement: ACCOUNT TYPE subfield (positions 5-6, fixed value 98) is not required when TAG = IT.
requirements.constraint_text: ACCOUNT TYPE data is not required

requirements.statement: EBT Program Data subelement has a maximum length of 264 bytes, allowing up to 6 occurrences of maximum variable length 44 bytes each.
requirements.constraint_text: Max 264 bytes total; up to 6 occurrences of up to 44 bytes each

requirements.statement: Valid TAG values for requests are 50 (HIP purchase/return amount) and IT (HIP Internet purchase shipping address/zip code).
Valid TAG values for responses are 51 (HIP incentive earned/returned) and 52 (HIP month-to-date incentive earned).
AMOUNT TYPE (positions 7-8) is not required when TAG = IT.
requirements.constraint_text: AMOUNT TYPE data is not required

requirements.statement: CURRENCY CODE (positions 9-11) has fixed value 840 (US Dollars) and is not required when TAG = IT.
requirements.constraint_text: CURRENCY CODE data is not required; otherwise fixed value 840

requirements.statement: AMOUNT DESCRIPTOR (position 12) has fixed value 0/C/D and is not required when TAG = IT.
requirements.constraint_text: AMOUNT DESCRIPTOR is not required; otherwise fixed value 0/C/D

requirements.statement: When TAG = 50, 51, or 52, DETAIL (positions 13-24) is a HIP dollar amount with fixed length 12 digits, right-aligned, zero-padded, 2 assumed decimal places.
requirements.constraint_text: DETAIL = 12-digit HIP dollar amount, right-aligned, zero-padded, 2 assumed decimals

requirements.statement: When TAG = IT, DETAIL is a shipping address of fixed length 37 alphanumeric characters: Address portion positions 5-32 (28 chars, left-aligned, space-filled) and Zip Code portion positions 33-41 (max 9 digits, left-aligned, space-filled).
requirements.constraint_text: DETAIL = 37 alphanumeric chars: 28-char Address (pos 5-32) + up to 9-digit Zip (pos 33-41), both left-aligned space-filled

requirements.statement: EBT Program Data AMOUNT TYPE valid values for requests: 50 (HIP purchase/return amount).
EBT Program Data AMOUNT TYPE valid values for responses: 51 (HIP incentive earned/returned), 52 (HIP month-to-date incentive earned).
Standard Message Data Segment (100) length is 78 bytes including field separators in this example.
The Product Code Data Segment (102) length in this example is 49 bytes including Field Separators and Product Data Field Delimiters.
requirements.constraint_text: Segment Length must account for separators and delimiters

requirements.statement: When EBT Program Data (Element 164) is used in a request containing a HIP purchase/return amount, Subelement 1 (Total Length) is formatted n3, right-aligned, zero-filled, and specifies the total length of all data in the entire message (e.g. '024' means 24 characters follow).
requirements.constraint_text: Subelement 1 = n3 right-aligned zero-filled total length

requirements.statement: Within EBT Program Data (Element 164), the TAG subelement value '50' indicates a HIP purchase/return amount follows; TAG is format n2.
requirements.constraint_text: Indicates HIP purchase/return amount data follows

requirements.statement: Within EBT Program Data (Element 164), the LEN subelement is format n2 and indicates the length of the Detail data that follows (e.g. '20' indicates 20 characters follow).
requirements.constraint_text: LEN = n2 length of Detail data

requirements.statement: Example EBT Program Data value '02450209850840C000000001234' demonstrates Element 164 format for a request containing one set of subelements (a HIP purchase/return amount).
When the EBT Program Data element is used in a request containing a HIP Purchase/Return Amount, Subelement 2 ACCOUNT TYPE must be '98' (HIP Account Type).

When the EBT Program Data element is used in a request containing a HIP Purchase/Return Amount, AMOUNT TYPE must be '40' (HIP Amount Type). Note: the raw value shown is '50' but the valid value is stated as 40.
flags: Discrepancy between example value 50 and stated valid value 40

requirements.statement: CURRENCY CODE subfield must be '840' (US Dollars) when used in a HIP Purchase/Return Amount request.
AMOUNT DESCRIPTOR must be one of '0', 'C', or 'D', where 0 or C indicate a credit amount and D indicates a debit amount.
DETAIL (HIP purchase/return amount) is a 12-digit numeric with two assumed decimal places, right-aligned and zero-padded (e.g., '000000001234' = $12.34).
requirements.constraint_text: n12, two assumed decimals, right-aligned, zero-padded
